postTitle: any chance of the Legacy Of Flan 3 server going back up?
commentSubject: I would love to make another online Legacy of Flan game, but I don't think I would attempt it. I never attempted another online game after that.The only Legacy of Flan game that still works is part 4 because it was totally offline.  I thought it was a pretty good one too, maybe I'll upload it to Gamejolt. :)
